rationale: The replication fully reproduces the paper's central theoretical claims: phase-amplitude mode mixing in iCDW (off-diagonal coefficient -0.212) versus decoupling in rCDW (off-diagonal ~1e-17), and the closed-form spectrum Eq.(12) matches to machine precision (4.4e-16 error). Equilibrium order parameters and phase selection also match analytically. The NV-center detection proposal (Eqs.13-15) was not attempted due to unspecified material parameters, and finite-q dispersion was not mapped, limiting coverage. However, all testable mean-field and collective-mode claims from the paper excerpt are quantitatively confirmed.
